# Repository coding instructions

Follow the repository-wide standards in [../AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for every code change.

This project is React 19 + Vite and deploys as a static GitHub Pages site. Do not assume Next.js or a backend. Inspect existing code before editing, preserve the current design system, keep dependencies lean, build accessible responsive UI, respect reduced motion, apply secure frontend practices, and run `npm run build` before finishing.

For UI work, consult Vercel Web Interface Guidelines and UI/UX Pro Max. For animations, consult Motion/GSAP documentation only when the complexity warrants a library. For security-sensitive work, consult OWASP guidance and report which checks were actually performed.
